newsitem.title: ITALY: Gross yield falls at Italy 2-yr CTZ bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Gross yield falls at Italy 2-yr CTZ bill auction.

text.p: Result for the 2.5 trillion lire auction of a third tranche of January 15, 1999 two-year Italian Treasury zero coupon certificates (CTZ).
Note - Results compare with a previous auction of a first tranche of the Jan 15, 1999 CTZs on January 10.

Result for the auction of a second tranche of July 15, 1998 18-month Italian Treasury zero coupon certificates (CTZ), of which 1.679 trillion lire worth was bid for and allocated against an offer of 2.50 trillion lire.
Note - Results compare with a previous auction of a first tranche of the new July 15, 1998 CTZs on January 10.
